content.short: Orderly Network is the next-gen trading infrastructure for Web3 builders, a permissionless and modular protocol with deep liquidity.
content.description: Orderly Network delivers next-generation trading infrastructure for Web3 builders—a permissionless, modular protocol backed by deep liquidity and a robust CLOB layer. The forthcoming Orderly V2 with an EVM expansion centers on interoperability, uniting liquidity across chains and enabling traders and decentralized exchanges to access the Orderly Network from Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Cosmos, and other networks, all within a seamless omnichain trading experience.
content.meta: Orderly Network offers next-gen, permissionless trading infrastructure for Web3 builders. Discover Orderly Network and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
